# Renov.lu

> Renov.lu is Luxembourg's comprehensive platform for energy renovation planning, offering free simulators for heat pumps, solar panels, and building efficiency improvements with integrated subsidy and ROI calculations.

Renov.lu provides Luxembourgish homeowners and property managers with practical tools to evaluate renovation costs, estimate government aids (Klimabonus), and calculate long-term energy savings. The platform specializes in heat pump sizing, solar photovoltaic analysis, and comprehensive building energy assessments.

## Key Topics

- Luxembourg energy renovation
- Klimabonus subsidies
- Heat pump (Pompe à Chaleur / PAC)
- SCOP efficiency rating
- Solar panels (Panneaux Solaires)
- VMC ventilation systems
- Energy efficiency building standards
- Renovation cost calculator
- Subsidy estimation
- Thermal insulation
- Heating system comparison
- Installation quotes
- Home energy assessment
- Building dimensioning
- TVA tax considerations

## Energy Renovation Simulators

- [Simulateur de Rénovation Énergétique - Luxembourg](https://renov.lu/renovation-energetique/simulateur): Free energy renovation simulator for Luxembourg with pricing, subsidies & ROI estimates
- [Simulateur Pompe à Chaleur Luxembourg - Dimensionnement & Aides](https://renov.lu/chauffage/pompe-a-chaleur/simulateur): Heat pump calculator for Luxembourg sizing, pricing, and subsidy estimation
- [Simulateur Photovoltaïque Luxembourg | Renov.lu](https://renov.lu/panneaux-solaires/simulateur): Solar panel simulator for Luxembourg with pricing, subsidies & performance analysis
- [Simulateur de Rénovation au Luxembourg](https://renov.lu/travaux-renovation/simulateur): Comprehensive renovation cost calculator for Luxembourg with aids & property impact
